title: Joshua Bible Quiz - Chapter 24
description: Ten questions on Joshua 24: the covenant at Shechem, Israel's choice to serve Yahweh, and Joshua's death.

questions.text: Where did Joshua gather all the tribes of Israel in this chapter?
questions.explanation: Joshua 24:1 says Joshua gathered all the tribes of Israel to Shechem.

questions.text: What did Yahweh give to Esau to possess?
questions.explanation: Joshua 24:4 says Yahweh gave Esau Mount Seir to possess it.

questions.text: When the Egyptians pursued the fathers to the Red Sea and they cried out to Yahweh, what did he put between them and the Egyptians?
questions.explanation: Joshua 24:6-7 says that when they cried out to Yahweh, he put darkness between them and the Egyptians and brought the sea on the Egyptians.

questions.text: Whom did Balak the son of Zippor call to curse Israel?
questions.explanation: Joshua 24:9 says Balak sent and called Balaam the son of Beor to curse them.

questions.text: What did Yahweh send before Israel to drive out the two kings of the Amorites?
questions.explanation: Joshua 24:12 says Yahweh sent the hornet before them, not with their sword or bow.

questions.text: What did Joshua declare about himself and his house?
questions.explanation: In Joshua 24:15 Joshua says, "as for me and my house, we will serve Yahweh."

answers.text: They would return beyond the River
They would choose the gods of the Amorites
They would wait for a sign

questions.text: Besides holy, how did Joshua describe Yahweh when he warned the people?
questions.explanation: Joshua 24:19 says Yahweh is a holy God and a jealous God.

answers.text: A God of one tribe only

questions.text: What did Joshua set up under the oak by the sanctuary of Yahweh?
questions.explanation: Joshua 24:26 says Joshua took a great stone and set it up under the oak by the sanctuary of Yahweh.

questions.text: How old was Joshua when he died?
questions.explanation: Joshua 24:29 says Joshua the son of Nun died, being one hundred ten years old.

questions.text: For how much had Jacob bought the ground where Joseph's bones were buried?
questions.explanation: Joshua 24:32 says Jacob bought the parcel of ground from the sons of Hamor for a hundred pieces of silver.
